label: GO step after an unrewarded common a2->S2 trial, early-to-mid episode
explanation: Fires only at GO (never at D1 or D2), and almost only when the previous trial was unrewarded (prev_reward==0 covers 99.9% of activations). Within those it needs the previous trial to have been a2 with a common transition to S2: unrewarded a1 trials and rare a1->S2 trials barely fire it (prev_state==2 scores lower than prev_action==2 & common). It is strongly limited to the first ~50 trials of an episode (rate 11% at trial 1, falling to about 0 after trial 60). Activation is also higher a few trials after a reversal and when the policy leans toward a2. All predicate variables are observed. Most missed activations (about 20%) are GO steps on the window first trial (rel -3), where the previous trial is outside the window, so the rule likely holds there but cannot be checked. The remaining errors are false positives in the eligible context, where precision is about 0.66. Adding a condition on the reward two trials back made it worse. Dev F1 0.71, mass recall 0.79.
